reviews.text: Good, but definitely needs some improvement. The app itself is good for drilling in quick information due to repetitive questions, but I feel it’s lacking in multiple choice questions. Another flaw is that it doesn’t really teach you the various buttons/components for the car dashboard, or which type of flasher the car is displaying. These are also the type of things I’m fairly certain that the examiner will instruct you to do, though driving lessons can help with that. Sometimes, a question will have a nearly identical answer to the correct option, and is still deemed wrong, or the choice correlates with the answer. One of the questions asked about what can result in distracted driving, and two answer choices made sense, given collisions DO cause traffic jams, but the traffic jam answer was deemed incorrect alongside the “both” option.

reviews.text:
Highly worth it. With me being nervous about my written test in a month, I tried this app because it had a very good number of positive reviews. I am blown away! It’s a Duolingo-style approach to learning the written rules of driving.

For starters, the UI is great and is very familiar because it looks exactly like something Apple themselves would make. The content asks a lot very good questions. The exam feature is extremely helpful and I’m hoping it will be an accurate gauge of what I can expect on the actual test. 

I haven’t even had this app for two hours, and I am already seriously impressed. The dev(s) thought of everything haptic feedback, sound effects, animations, content, etc. Definitely feel like I can take the test right this second and I would ace it.

Some people may get turned off by the price, but look at it this way most states charge a fee if you fail a test and attempt to retake it. Getting the app is basically insurance if you dedicate your time into studying, you’re very likely going to pass. If you don’t and you fail, you might end up paying a few extra bucks for taking another attempt, rather than just downloading this in the first place. It’s pretty simple stuff, anyways. If you’re confident with your test already or have an alternative app or way to study, then the price might be too much to justify. But if you want a little more piece of mind or like this type of learning style better, than this is definitely helpful!

I myself bought the one-month subscription for $16-17. I am fairly confident that this will greatly help me pass! 

TLDR, ⭐️ 5/5 from me, highly recommend!
